baseline_scope: Working-tree snapshot before poller.c/util.c changes; includes the previously completed ping.c refactor. Source hashes identify the exact inputs.
runtime_environment: macOS AppleClang C17; database, SNMP, PHP, process spawning, process termination, and script FD operations are mocked. Regex threads, worker lifecycle, semaphores, logging, config-file parsing, and fatal exits execute the real implementations.

availability.coverage: Each availability mode 0..7 with upstream ping result UP/DOWN; primary and secondary worker behavior. These are caller-admission tests; the upstream availability decision matrix is covered separately by test_ping_behavior.
availability.preserved: SNMP v1/v2 with an empty community bypasses ping and updates UP; stream availability also bypasses ping. Normal checks update host status only from worker 1. Worker 1 owns the host UPDATE. Ping-only mode still performs that UPDATE, releases connections, and ends MySQL thread state; it returns before assigning host_errors.

retry_semantics.coverage: Script-slot exhaustion, one interrupted FD wait followed by readiness, timeout and empty reads.
retry_semantics.preserved: exec_poll loops while ++retries < script_timeout*15 and sleeps 10 ms between failed slot requests. A 2-second setting gives 29 slot attempts. Slot exhaustion returns an empty allocated string, not U. EINTR recomputes the remaining timeout and retries the wait. A timeout kills the tracked child with SIGKILL and closes its pipe. Ping/SNMP retries remain delegated to their existing implementation.

output_formatting.coverage: Numeric, multipart, hexadecimal, text-normalization, undefined, and empty PHP outputs; script output; date formats; JSON log field names, escaping, severity and stdout/stderr routing; configuration final-line handling; buffered error message.
output_formatting.preserved: is_numeric mutates trailing trim characters and keeps its existing leading-space/quote quirks. Multipart acceptance counts delimiters versus spaces and accepts a colon or exclamation without spaces. Hex conversion retains its existing mutation and floating-point implementation. Config parsing ignores an unterminated final line. JSON PID/time/thread values are verified structurally, not frozen in the trace.

database_writes.coverage: Byte-exact db_query/db_insert traces for host availability state, timing, local/remote poller output, Boost duplication, multi-row delimiters, profile scheduling, errors, and settings upsert variants.
database_writes.preserved: Host updates use LOCAL on worker 1. Output goes to REMOTE only for poller_id>1 and REMOTE_ONLINE; Boost duplicates output when both flags are set. Settings support VALUES(value) and the MySQL alias rs.value form. SQL templates, formatting and batching thresholds remain unchanged.
database_writes.limitation: Statements are captured at the database adapter boundary; no live database or MySQL server parsing/transaction test is performed.

script_protocols.coverage: PHP dispatch through the real poller output path; exec_poll slot admission, read, EINTR, timeout, close and empty-result paths.
script_protocols.preserved: exec_poll returns bytes from one read up to RESULTS_BUFFER-1. Despite its one-line comment, that read can contain multiple lines; the test preserves them. Timeout/empty-read results become U, while slot exhaustion returns empty. PHP command framing remains in unchanged php.c.
script_protocols.limitation: The PHP adapter is mocked. Actual PHP worker CRLF framing/restarts are source-inspected rather than integration-tested.

shutdown.coverage: Worker thread start/join, initialization semaphore, completed-thread semaphore, script-slot restoration, fatal exit code, message suffix, and parent-only PHP cleanup.
shutdown.preserved: Worker cleanup runs through pthread cleanup handlers; removing the unreachable exit after pthread_exit does not change the process lifecycle. die() prints its existing context suffix, closes PHP only for an initialized parent, and exits using set.exit_code.
shutdown.limitation: Global SIGTERM drain and signal handling live in unchanged spine.c/error.c and are source-inspected, not signal-integration-tested.

source_inspected_contracts.util_remote_sync: poller_push_data_to_main copies host status and poller scheduling state to the remote DB; keeps existing 500-row batch logic and SQL dialect selection. Its template strings are unchanged; this full synchronization path is not runtime-tested.
source_inspected_contracts.configuration_loading: read_config_options publishes capabilities and reads overrides/database values. Its SQL text and option precedence remain unchanged; only buffer initialization and loop-variable scope change here.
source_inspected_contracts.php_framing: php_cmd appends CRLF, holds a process lock, and restarts failed communication; php_close sends quit followed by CRLF and closes/terminates the worker.
source_inspected_contracts.global_shutdown: SIGTERM sets the stop flag, stops dispatch between devices and limits draining to the earlier poller deadline or 30 seconds. Main cleanup closes script workers, DB/SNMP and platform state. SIGINT remains the separate fatal-handler path.

compatibility_checks.string_literals: All C string literal tokens in util.c are identical; all poller.c string literals except the equivalent multipart delimiter searches are identical. This includes SQL, script commands, output formats and failure messages.
compatibility_checks.no_annex_k: No _s interfaces, Annex K feature macros, or compatibility library added.
compatibility_checks.headers: Read-only poller command, timestamp and multipart input parameters now use const; existing writable callers remain compatible.

safety_and_ownership_notes: The error buffer and its counters now belong to the poll_host stack instead of three unchecked heap allocations. This adds DBL_BUFSIZE bytes to a worker stack; successful-poll output is unchanged.
rtrim no longer forms a pointer before the start of an empty/all-trim buffer.
ctype calls convert input bytes to unsigned char before classification.
Bounded copy uses memcpy only after computing the bounded byte count; original non-overlap precondition is preserved.
No parser-policy, retry, batching, SQL, script-framing, or signal-policy changes are intended.

validation.baseline_trace: Pass against original implementations and refactored implementations
validation.sanitizers: poller_util_behavior, ping_c17, ping_behavior, dump_config and json_log pass with AddressSanitizer and UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer
validation.full_suite: 21 tests passed; full Spine executable built successfully.
